value: RPG where you play as a class of highschool students fighting in a VR fantasy game. Girls vs Boys, but the boys team is tiny.

After joining a full-dive VR experience with your entire class, you discover that all the boys spawned as bug-sized tinies, while the girls are normal size. While the boys can grind bug enemies to gain XP, they stand no chance against the girls (who only gain XP from crushing the boys).
